sources.quote: Update: Prompt caching is Generally Available on the Anthropic API. Prompt caching is also available in preview in Amazon Bedrock and on Google Cloud’s Vertex AI. (December 17, 2024)
sources.supports: The provider page dates the API prompt-caching GA update to December 17, 2024, before the June 2025 models.dev period.

notes: Anthropic's page lists Claude 3.5 Sonnet at $3/$15 per MTok and prompt-cache prices of $3.75/write and $0.30/read; it also dates API general availability to December 17, 2024. This makes the recorded change a models.dev fix, and its added $0.30 cache_write is itself inconsistent with Anthropic's listed write price; the Internet Archive CDX endpoint returned its temporary-offline page, so no snapshot bracket was available.
